T1566.001.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Attachment
mitigations: Train users to recognize malicious attachments and macro prompts
Block macro execution from internet-sourced Office documents
Use attachment sandboxing at the mail gateway

T1059.001.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
mitigations: Enable script block and module logging
Restrict execution policy and use application control (WDAC)

T1059.003.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
mitigations: Use application control to restrict cmd.exe where feasible

T1003.001.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
mitigations: Enable Credential Guard on supported hosts

T1550.003.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Ticket
mitigations: Reset the krbtgt account password twice to invalidate forged tickets
Monitor for anomalous Kerberos TGS/TGT requests

T1078.002.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
mitigations: Enforce least privilege for domain admin accounts
Alert on domain admin logons to unexpected hosts
